variant.title: Greater Than Sudoku
variant.description: The open side of each inequality sign faces the larger digit, and its point faces the smaller digit.
rule_guide.title: Greater Than Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: The open side of each inequality sign faces the larger digit, and its point faces the smaller digit.
rule_guide.item_3: Adjacent cells without an inequality sign have no additional order restriction.
